gaps.explanation: pp11-12 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints seven enterprise columns (p11 Golf, Sanitation, Solid Waste Disposal Facility, Sanitary Sewer; p12 Water, Storm Water, Airport); none is in detail[] (Internal Service Funds column not used). JSON receipts = Sales 33,342,101 + Miscellaneous 749,140 + Intergovernmental 6,039,376 + Investment earnings 824,549 + Gains (losses) on disposal 1,046,844 = 42,002,010. By column: Golf 1,315,283 + 10,000 + 203,500 = 1,528,783; Sanitation 5,781,331 + 46,500 + 15,954 + 95,810 = 5,939,595; Solid Waste 2,316,730 + 95,034 + 336,248 - 35,445 = 2,712,567; Sanitary Sewer 9,424,814 + 38,479 + 163,191 = 9,626,484; Water 10,479,307 + 362,972 + 143,561 = 10,985,840; Storm Water 639,308 + 34,130 + 373,506 = 1,046,944; Airport 3,385,328 + 196,155 + 6,023,422 + 51,609 + 505,283 = 10,161,797. Sum 42,002,010 = statement total. The Solid Waste gains row is printed (35,445) and is added as printed (negative).
